behavior: AC1-AC5: secrets run refuses an environment dump given directly, by path, or inside a shell snippet (path, redirect, quotes, backslashes, a line continuation, any case), and runs legitimate tools
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/cmd/ -run 'TestAssertSafeChildCommand|TestRunChildPTY_HonoursTheIntrospectionGuard' -count=1 -v 2>&1); rc=$?; n=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^=== RUN'); [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$n" -ge 1 ]

behavior: AC7: an injected secret never reaches stdout or stderr, whole or split across writes of any size
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/cmd/ -run 'TestRedactWriter|TestRunChildPTY_RedactsASecretSplitAcrossWrites' -count=1 -v 2>&1); rc=$?; n=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^=== RUN'); [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$n" -ge 1 ]
